meta.name: testing
meta.description: Use when writing or reviewing Flutter/Dart tests (unit, widget, golden), fixing flaky tests, adding coverage, or choosing between unit and widget tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写、审查并修复 Flutter/Dart 测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Flutter/Dart 并需要提升测试质量
copy.tagline_en: Write and review Flutter/Dart tests, fix flaky ones, and boost coverage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Flutter/Dart apps and want more reliable tests

howto.what: 它会使助手在编写或审查 Flutter/Dart 测试时，遵循特定模式：确保测试能捕获真实回归、使用 group 组织、按 'should' 命名、采用 mocktail 模拟、以及区分单元与组件测试等。
howto.when: 当你请求编写或审查 Flutter/Dart 测试（单元、widget、golden 测试），修复不稳定测试，增加覆盖率，或选择测试类型时触发。

say.text: 为这个 Counter 类写单元测试。
say.note: 助手会按 group 和 'should' 命名生成测试。

say.text: 帮我审查这个测试文件，看是否有只测 mock 的情况。
say.note: 助手会检查测试的有效性和覆盖率。

say.text: 如何给 LoginCubit 写组件测试？
say.note: 助手会展示 widget 测试模式。

howto.what_en: It causes the assistant to follow specific patterns when writing or reviewing Flutter/Dart tests: ensuring tests can catch real regressions, using group() organization, naming with 'should', mocking with mocktail, and distinguishing unit vs widget tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to write or review Flutter/Dart tests (unit, widget, golden), fix flaky tests, add coverage, or choose between test types.

say_en.text: Write unit tests for this Counter class.
say_en.note: Assistant will generate tests with group and 'should' naming.

say_en.text: Review this test file for mock-only pitfalls.
say_en.note: Assistant checks test validity and coverage.

say_en.text: How to write a widget test for LoginCubit?
